facts.value: You need to go to the SUSI website, sign up, and fill out the application form.
SUSI explains some of the trickier bits in its guide.

The application form follows six sections: Section A: Your personal details; Section B: Nationality and residency; Section C: Course details, previous education, and info about any financial support you’ve received; Section D: Personal details of your parents/guardians/partner, etc.; Section E: Info on any dependent children or relevant people in your household; Section F: Income information.
You should know your PPSN numbers for yourself, your parents/guardians, your partner, etc.; and income details for yourself, your parents/guardians, your partner, etc.
